cases.name: depth-positive

files.src/stream.py:
from kafka import KafkaProducer, KafkaConsumer
def transfer():
    producer = KafkaProducer()
    consumer = KafkaConsumer('events')
    producer.send('events', b'x')
    consumer.poll()
    consumer.commit()

cases.tradeoff: L3 requires attributed producer, consumer, and explicit delivery-control calls in the same function component; the common split producer/consumer architecture is missed.
